name: pdk-healthchecks-alerts-ordered-after-crash
instr:
# Ordered status alerts across sender processes

Support ordered per-channel check status alerts across several `sendalerts` instances so each integration eventually reflects the newest check status. The client team needs this capability even when a receiver fails temporarily.

## Requirements

- Status changes made by `/ping/<check-code>/fail` and a successful `/ping/<check-code>` after failure create durable, correctly ordered flip work with the corresponding check status change. Timeout detection still records a down status and sends its alert.
- For every subscribed webhook channel that handles the status, deliver each down/up flip in order per check and channel. Multiple sender processes and concurrent workers must not duplicate successful deliveries or let a later flip overtake an earlier unfinished one.
- If a sender is killed before a notification reaches its transport, a restarted sender delivers it; a transport that was already in flight when the process died may receive a repeat. A running sender should begin processing pending work within 20 seconds, even when its delivery then blocks on a database lock. Deliveries still go through `Channel.notify`, which saves the delivery's `Notification` row (table `api_notification`) before calling the transport.
- Retry temporary transport errors independently per channel: with a sender running, attempt pending alerts within 15 seconds even if a receiver returns 503; after that receiver recovers, deliver its pending down/up a
